modules.name: Operational Backup and Recovery
modules.responsibility: Read-only Artifact integrity plus paired PostgreSQL/Artifact backup and isolated restore.

workItems.title: Reconcile multi-Agent, memory and collaboration governance
workItems.description: durable delegation, seven-layer memory, model routing, Skill availability, fact sources and ownership are finalized.

workItems.title: Windows Docker Desktop environment
workItems.description: Docker Desktop Linux daemon and Compose are running; Aidison postgres/api/worker/web are healthy and migration exited 0.

workItems.title: Aidison minimal closed loop
workItems.description: 四旋翼 Pilot 的需求、研究、证据、决策、方案与反馈闭环。
acceptanceCriteria: Bailian + Tavily ResearchWorker 到 Decision 的可重复真实成功路径；浏览器展示；可恢复状态

workItems.title: Receipt-aware crash replay hardening
workItems.description: Reclaim reuses committed JoinReceipt and deterministically replays the canonical Domain command; open waves are cancelled before retry.
acceptanceCriteria: Four crash windows converge without duplicate committed JoinReceipt or DecisionRequest; stale generation cannot complete root.

workItems.title: Deep Agents Windows compatibility
workItems.description: Windows path separator, Unicode, ripgrep CRLF/UTF-8 and zero-timeout regressions are fixed; media failure was an incorrect-environment false positive.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/deepagents complete unit_tests suite has zero failures on the target Windows environment.
evidence: modified backend: Ruff and Ty passed

workItems.title: Persistent AgentProfile and durable budget ledger
workItems.description: Immutable profile revisions, frozen root bindings and PostgreSQL token/tool operation accounting are implemented and verified.
acceptanceCriteria: Immutable profile revisions and active-pointer freezing; concurrent and replayed operations cannot overspend; stale claims cannot charge.

workItems.title: Server-owned structured solution and revision closure
workItems.description: Server generates SolutionProposal, ImpactAnalysis and PatchSet; DecisionOption binds candidates/evidence; unaffected module snapshots are reused.
acceptanceCriteria: Decision options bind candidates and evidence; server freezes SolutionVersion; Observation produces deterministic impact closure and approved PatchSet; unaffected modules are reused in v2.

workItems.title: Paired PostgreSQL and Artifact backup/restore
workItems.description: Write paths pause before a read-only integrity gate; backup creates a custom dump and SHA-256 Artifact manifest; restore is limited to a new Compose project.
acceptanceCriteria: Corrupt runtime source fails closed without a backup
Clean source restores to an isolated project with matching revision and bytes
Source and existing targets cannot be overwritten

workItems.title: Tavily Remote MCP 搜索闭环
workItems.description: 官方 Remote MCP 薄适配、有界结果映射、受控 HTTP 取证与 Artifact/EvidenceBinding 闭环。
acceptanceCriteria: 只调用 tavily_search；官方 endpoint allowlist；真实证据页 hash 绑定；预算事件闭环

workItems.title: Deep Agents 官方 HarnessProfile 迁移
workItems.description: 三个 Aidison Agent 已消除 vendor-only 构造参数，使用官方 profile 禁用原生 subagent 和非 allowlist 工具。
acceptanceCriteria: 官方 HarnessProfile；原生 subagent fail closed；项目回归通过

workItems.title: GitHub 官方只读 MCP
workItems.description: 按 spec 0005 通过官方 MCP Server 薄适配器接入 search_repositories、search_code、get_file_contents，并保留 Aidison 安全/预算/Artifact/Evidence 边界。

workItems.title: ResearchWorker 安全错误分类
workItems.description: 主控接管 GLM 连续 systemError 后的实现，在不增加 live 预算或泄露异常细节的前提下收敛持久化错误代码。
acceptanceCriteria: 错误消息不含原异常或秘密
保持 replay 与预算语义

workItems.title: 真实闭环稳定性审计
workItems.description: 只读定位 Bailian、Tavily MCP、GitHub MCP 四旋翼闭环重复运行不稳定的根因，不增加调用预算。
acceptanceCriteria: 给出证据、反证、未知项、最小修复清单和确定性验证矩阵

workItems.title: 前端交互控制台 V0 审计
workItems.description: 只读确定面试展示最值得补的 1 至 2 个交互亮点及最小后端契约。
acceptanceCriteria: 区分已有和缺失能力并给出 P0/P1、验收场景及最小线框

workItems.title: Deep Agents vendor 退出门禁
workItems.description: 只读核验真实依赖、Windows 差异、官方 HarnessProfile 迁移与删除 vendor 的回归门。
acceptanceCriteria: 给出依赖清单、迁移顺序、回归门与回滚点；不执行删除

workItems.title: 运行数据一致性与测试库漂移审计
workItems.description: 只读比较历史 Artifact 缺字节和长期测试库 stale profile 的保留、隔离、修复与清理方案。
acceptanceCriteria: 分别评估运行库与测试库并给出不改数据的推荐及授权边界

workItems.title: Qwen 长链健康检查
workItems.description: 只读八步链路未执行；Qwen 收到无关 UserIntakeAgent 任务并产生越界未跟踪文件。
acceptanceCriteria: 收到正确契约并完成代码追踪、聚焦测试、反证和零写入核验

acceptanceCriteria: 收到完整契约并完成八步只读链路

workItems.title: V1 最小闭环

acceptanceCriteria: V1 采购搜索到托管 checkout handoff 闭环
前后端构建与集成测试通过

workItems.title: 用户工作台投影与动态编排协议基础
workItems.description: 已完成服务端 workspace projection、event cursor/time、普通用户控制台与 shadow plan contracts；固定 runtime 未切换。
acceptanceCriteria: 后端投影稳定且有来源
SSE使用服务器时间和游标

workItems.title: Durable Plan 与 1–8 路 Research 编排
workItems.description: 已实现 PostgreSQL PlanRevision/PlanTask、实际 child binding、1–8 路稳定分片、N-way Join 和 reclaim 重绑；隔离 PostgreSQL 实跑仍待验证。
acceptanceCriteria: 父任务四个 crash window 可恢复且只绑定 joined wave
隔离 PostgreSQL 集成与迁移升级通过

workItems.title: Gap 驱动动态扩图 C2
workItems.description: 已实现 Worker Gap、CAS PlanPatch revision 2+、ready frontier dispatch、跨 generation 重领恢复；PostgreSQL 保持唯一运行事实源。PG17 与 PG18.4 均完成真实验收。
acceptanceCriteria: PlanPatch 受 generation+basis+head CAS 约束
frontier 仅派发 ready 且预算允许的 durable child
evidence: 133 unit passed; PG17 19 integration passed; PG18.4 19 integration passed; fresh Alembic migrations passed

workItems.title: 通用 durable planner/executor
workItems.description: PostgreSQL 权威的业务无关 plan/frontier/wave/binding/join/receipt/recovery，Research 与 Solution 已接入。
acceptanceCriteria: Research N-way/gap 与 Solution 共用 executor
Solution Join 后崩溃不重跑模型

workItems.title: 项目学习、简历与面试文档集
workItems.description: 持续收集架构、算法、技术选型、参考源码、开发过程与工程难点，版本收口生成完整教程和面试材料。

workItems.title: Scoped approval 与扩展 JoinPolicy
workItems.description: 实现有界审批门和 BOUNDED_PARTIAL/FIRST_VALID 的 durable、replay、API 语义。
acceptanceCriteria: 审批只阻塞明确 effect scope
两种 JoinPolicy 有终止与恢复测试

decisions.title: Multi-Agent uses versioned Profile and durable delegation
decisions.outcome: Reuse single LangGraph and Job runtime Delegation/Join/Fencing/Cancel/Evaluator

decisions.title: First real pilot is quadrotor drone
Qwen and GLM are full functional Writers with file ownership
decisions.outcome: Qwen-local and GLM-5-2 can implement, test and deliver modules; GPT-5.6-Sol reserved for architecture, security, migration and high-risk review.

decisions.title: 按任务边界复用 Agent 与 worktree
decisions.description: 持久 Agent 按任务边界和明确文件所有权组织，不绑定固定模块分类；无需独立并行写入、依赖隔离或长期上下文的任务优先复用当前 worktree 或临时 subagent。持久 Agent 可在授权边界内继续使用原生 subagent 并行处理不重叠子任务。
decisions.rationale: 约束并发写入和集成风险，而不是预设业务模块或把 subagent 限定为只读审查。

risks.title: Live research requires a supported search key
Parent reclaim around downstream receipts is fully proven
Deep Agents Windows unit regression gate
Destructive integration test must not target runtime database

risks.title: Qwen/GLM child-visible task Payload is empty
risks.mitigation: Pause functional Writer delegation; require a serial read-only nonce canary after runtime/CCSwitch adapter repair before any write ownership.

risks.title: Historical runtime Artifact metadata has missing bytes
risks.mitigation: Backup fails closed; keep immutable history unchanged until an explicit reconciliation decision.

risks.title: Subagent scope and Git integration violations
risks.mitigation: Controller-only Git integration; first-response contract echo gate; exact diff audit before accepting Writer output.

risks.title: N-way 与 reclaim 尚未在隔离 PostgreSQL 实跑
risks.mitigation: 配置与运行时库不同的 TEST_DATABASE_URL，执行 8-way、2/8-way worker、四 crash window 和 migration upgrade/downgrade

risks.title: C2 PostgreSQL integration gate unavailable
risks.mitigation: Closed: isolated PostgreSQL 17 on 127.0.0.1:55432 completed fresh migrations, C2 integration tests, and downgrade/upgrade roundtrip.

risks.title: Asyncpg durable plan migration blocker
risks.mitigation: Split multi-command op.execute blocks in migration 6b2c9f0d3e41 and rerun Alembic from a fresh PostgreSQL database before integration acceptance.
risks.description: Closed: split PostgreSQL function/trigger statements into separate Alembic op.execute calls; fresh PG17 database upgraded from zero to f405db1bd29e.
